aiReviewer: OpenAI GPT-6 (AI editorial review only; not independent human review)
reviewNotes: Completed 36 original low-typing questions. Reviewed every full German sentence and all four offered options for meaning, grammar, competing defensible answers, bilingual hints and explanations, and distinct contexts. Two inherited CEFR labels (anhaben B1 and anschauen B2) deferred rather than padded. Corrected anpassen separability, unidiomatic ansprechen example, misleading anschaffen gloss and narrowed polysemous verbs. Existing objective catalogs and earlier enrichment batches inspected for overlaps. CEFR levels remain inherited claims, not certification; no human approval, independent rights clearance, publication or measured learning transfer.
